verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official, versioned CLI (0.205+) for working with the platform from a local terminal or automation scripts. It covers Unity Catalog objects, and API reference pages include CLI usage examples. A separate documented CLI submits GPU training workloads from a laptop, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page. Missing for 10: evidence of agent/AI-native-specific CLI ergonomics (e.g., structured output designed for agent use), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
